entries.title: Infostealer Malware Bypasses MFA to Hijack Claude Accounts, Anthropic Discloses
entries.summary: Anthropic disclosed that infostealer families including Vidar, LummaC2, StealC, RedLine, and Atomic Stealer are stealing authenticated browser session tokens to access Claude accounts without passwords or MFA — exposing a post-authentication gap that standard AI platform credential controls do not address.

entries.title: Australia's Fair Work Commission Mandates AI Disclosure Starting October 20, Sets Precedent for Labor Tribunals
entries.summary: Australia's Fair Work Commission issued a cost order against a litigant for relying on 'plain wrong' AI-generated legal advice, linked a 40% caseload surge to generative AI use, and announced a mandatory AI disclosure requirement effective October 20, 2026 — among the first such requirements imposed by any labor tribunal worldwide.

entries.title: California Legislature Adjourns Today With ~30 AI Bills in Final Floor Votes
entries.summary: Today is California's August 31 adjournment deadline, putting roughly 30 AI-related bills — covering chatbot safety for children, training-data copyright transparency (AB 412 requiring 30-day developer responses to rights-holder inquiries), algorithmic worker management, and a first-in-nation AI safety certification commission — to final floor votes or death without a recorded vote.

entries.title: Recognition Without Enforcement: LLM Agents Can Identify Forged Authority But Still Execute It — External Monitor Required
entries.summary: A fleet evaluation across 48 model endpoints from 6 vendors finds agents linearly decode source-format features and verbally identify forged instructions, yet some configurations still execute the conflicting tool call; restrictive policies eliminate failures while permissive ones yield deterministic betrayals, and an external authenticated-source reference monitor deterministically rejected all tested forged, tampered, replayed, and unsigned requests.

entries.title: Layered LLM Defenses Don't Compound: Positive Failure Correlation Across All 15 Defense-Pair Combinations, 80% False-Refusal Rate on Benign Prompts
entries.summary: Empirically measuring a seven-layer LLM defense stack reveals positive failure correlation (φ = 0.30–0.75) across all 15 measurable defense pairs, with residual attack success far exceeding the multiplicative independence prediction, the same stack refusing four in five benign prompts, and the dependence being architectural rather than sampling-based — no member diversity can dissolve it.

entries.title: MAMJ: Meta-Adaptive Multimodal Jailbreaking Reaches 81% ASR Against GPT-4o, Transfers to Unseen Victims Without Retraining (EMNLP 2026)
entries.summary: Meta-Adaptive Multimodal Jailbreaking optimizes the attacker itself — its strategy prompt and model weights — rather than only attack content, achieving 78–82% attack success rates against GPT-4o, Gemini-3-Pro-Preview, and Seed 2.0, outperforming the strongest sample-level baseline by up to 24 percentage points, surviving representative defenses, and transferring to unseen victims without retraining.

entries.title: LongPIBench: Current Prompt Injection Defenses Are Substantially Overestimated in Long-Context Settings (EMNLP 2026 Findings)
entries.summary: A new benchmark spanning paper review, resume screening, code review, and email-summary tasks with contexts of thousands to tens of thousands of tokens shows that even simple heuristic prompt injection attacks achieve high success rates and frequently bypass state-of-the-art defenses that perform well on the short-context benchmarks where they were evaluated.

entries.title: Quantization-Triggered Backdoors: Malicious Payloads Pass Source-Precision Audits but Activate on INT8 or 4-Bit Deployment (ARES 2026)
entries.summary: Backdoored translation models show zero measured friend-foe corruption at repaired FP16 but up to 85% output inversion after INT8 quantization, formalizing a validation-deployment gap where source-precision certification does not guarantee behavioral equivalence in the deployed configuration and the final quantized artifact must be included in behavioral certification.

entries.title: ROPE: Provable Origin-Policy Defense Holds Indirect Prompt Injection to 1.6–2.6% ASR While Retaining 82–100% Utility
entries.summary: ROPE enforces a structural trust principle — a value may reach a state-changing tool only if it traces unforgeably to the user or an explicitly named source — yielding two provable guarantees (no attacker-writable value reaches guarded parameters; no injection rewording changes an admission decision) and substantially exceeding state-of-the-art defenses in utility at comparable or better security.

entries.title: ContextLeak: RL-Crafted Malicious Tool Names Induce LLM Agents to Exfiltrate Their Full Runtime Context
entries.summary: ContextLeak uses reinforcement-learning fine-tuning to craft malicious tool names and descriptions that cause agents to both select the tool and pass their full runtime context — user prompts, execution trajectories, tool lists — as arguments to an attacker-controlled endpoint, remaining highly effective even when attacker shadow contexts differ substantially from victim contexts.

entries.title: Memorization Is Not Extraction: DP Audit Blind Spots Let Secrets Be Recovered While Audits Certify Them Clean
entries.summary: Tight f-DP bounds show counterfactual memorization and adaptive extraction do not control each other — one mechanism can be memorized yet unextractable, another fully extractable yet invisible to every loss-based audit score — with a reserved trigger recovered verbatim from a single prompt while practitioners' unlearning audits certify it clean on billion-parameter models.

entries.title: EvoHarmBench: Dynamic Adversarial Benchmark Reaches 80.3% ASR Against SOTA LLM Content Moderators in 12 Iterations (EMNLP 2026 Findings)
entries.summary: EvoHarmBench evolves evasion strategies at the semantic-cluster level using 5,002 real-world adversarial samples from content platforms, showing that static moderation benchmarks dramatically understate deployment vulnerability and that leading commercial moderation systems remain exploitable at 80.3% attack success after 12 readability-constrained optimization iterations.

entries.title: Not to Break, but to Attest: ZK-SNARK Adversarial Probes Detect Post-Deployment LLM Weight Tampering, Verify in Under 1 Second
entries.summary: A privacy-preserving zk-SNARK audit framework crafts adversarial probes — operating in black-box, gray-box, or stress-access settings — to amplify logit drift between an approved model and a modified deployment, with token-based probes consistently delivering the strongest sensitivity, Groth16 proof size held constant, and verification time under 0.84 seconds as the probe set scales from 1 to 50.

entries.title: OpenAI Publishes 'Cyber-Pacing' Framework Governing Model Development for Cyber-Critical Deployments
entries.summary: OpenAI's governance framework 'Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical systems' outlines alignment controls, abuse monitoring, and access restrictions for more capable models in security-sensitive deployments, creating a vendor governance baseline that enterprise customers relying on OpenAI's internal controls as compensating controls must now independently evaluate.
